scope: Current local working tree including user uncommitted engine changes; focused review of Claude findings and affected claims/figures, not an exhaustive proof of all guide claims.

findings.conclusion: Guide retains working-tree fanout 1024 / uint16 selectors / temporary repair index, explicitly distinguishing committed a7fc519d.
Earlier apply finalizes transaction deltas; later nonzero staging is rejected; PRE_COMMIT applies only when not finalized.
Synchronous apply, transaction callback and subtransaction callback have separate exact anchors.
Split retrieval and merge checker are linked separately.
Bare backend 4/32/8 differs from OOM-100M and TPC-C setup defaults 32/1024/256; overrides remain possible.
Direct updater clamps a negative calculated count to zero and writes a zero hash whenever resulting count is zero; this is not a heap-emptiness proof.
SPI leaf UPDATE requires a nonnegative result and clears hash at zero; ancestor SPI plan clamps with GREATEST.
A nonempty successful split recomputes child and splitting-node totals from scanned heap rows; ancestors are not reconciled.
Only a nonzero scan count differing from a positive target count logs DEBUG1; hash-only mismatch has no corresponding check.
Zero scanned rows returns before split rebuild and before count-mismatch logging.
Build actively rejects already-staged DML in the same transaction.
Non-READY branch is present with caught-up INVALID/REBUILD_REQUIRED exception; current status helper always READY makes it inactive.
Selective discovery requires one Merkle key column, an existing node table and an indisprimary application index.
Ineligible tables present locally are checksummed; full copy occurs only for mismatch. Absent local ineligible tables are skipped.
Matching roots with enabled failed heap verification cause full copy; matching roots with verify off/pass return.
Roots differing without differing leaf ranges expand to whole-partition ranges in selective machinery, not an immediate full-table copy.
Post-selective unequal roots or enabled failed heap verification cause full copy; operational errors can return failure.
Full copy rebuilds local Merkle indexes in a separate transaction before DELETE plus COPY.
Inspected dump/scale/index pipeline creates no application PK constraints. Seven Merkle keys are composite; warehouse/item also lack real PKs. No nine-table selective path is implied by this setup.
Artifact validation and static/manual source review are separate; no build, database instance, benchmark, or live catalog inspection was run.

note: Source hashes bind this review to the inspected bytes. Artifact/PNG checks belong in validation.json and do not establish source correctness.
